items.title: Outlook: Multi Account Search
items.description: Users will be able to see results from multiple mailboxes interweaved in a single ranked list and will be able to do standard mail actions.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Optional Public CDN Support in Brand Center Setup
items.description:
We are updating the Brand Center setup experience so that administrators can set up Brand Center without enabling Public CDN.
Today, Public CDN is enabled as part of Brand Center setup, even when an organization only wants to use branding governance capabilities that do not require it. With this update, organizations can begin using Brand Center while deferring Public CDN until they need capabilities that depend on it, such as organizational fonts.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Schedule Channel Meetings from Outlook Calendar
items.description: Users will be able to schedule Microsoft Teams channel meetings directly from Outlook Calendar. This streamlines meeting creation and helps keep discussions and meeting content connected in the appropriate channel.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Manage rental service demand with work order requests
items.description:
Rental organizations need to coordinate commercial rental activity, equipment availability, asset condition, and service execution across multiple teams and applications. Service needs can arise while equipment is in stock, in transit, at a customer site, or being returned, but those needs don’t always require an immediate work order.
This feature connects rental operations in Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management with Dynamics 365 Field Service by introducing fleet items and work ord

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Book Work Orders with Multiple Requirements
items.description:
Dispatchers can now select which resource requirement to schedule when booking a work order that has multiple requirements. The new Book experience is available from both the work order form and list view, and shows relevant details such as requirement duration, time windows, resource preferences, booking status, and links to active bookings.
Work orders with a single resource requirement continue directly to the configured Schedule Assistant or Quick Book experience. The requirement picker is a

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Customize blocked file extensions for Weaponizable File Protection
items.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding admin controls for Weaponizable File Protection. Administrators will be able to customize which file types are blocked in Teams to align with their organization's security requirements or continue using the Microsoft-recommended default list. This added flexibility helps organizations tailor file protection policies while maintaining a secure collaboration environment.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
items.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Explicit recording and transcription consent for PSTN participants now available in GCC High and DoD
items.description: We are introducing explicit recording and transcription consent support for PSTN participants joining Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD environments. This feature is already available in Public and GCC clouds and is now being extended to sovereign environments. After this rollout, when a meeting is being recorded or transcribed, PSTN participants will be prompted to provide explicit consent before they can unmute and participate. If consent is not provided, participants will remain mu

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage,

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
items.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
items.description: Administrators can choose a severity threshold and receive alerts when a new Edge update includes security fixes that meet or exceed that level, including zero day fixes. This helps organizations quickly identify updates that may require attention, while avoiding unnecessary notifications for routine releases.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill
items.description: For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Schedule Teams Channel Meeting from Win32
items.description: Users can now schedule Teams Channel Meetings from Win32 (Outlook classic client)

items.title: SharePoint: New Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
items.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android is redesigned around the personalized SharePoint Discover experience, bringing your most relevant files, sites, people, and news together in one place, with improved site browsing, in-app file previews, refreshed news and search, dark mode, and better performance.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automatically complete Project Tasks when field work is finished
items.description:
Keep project plans aligned with field execution by automatically completing a linked Project Task when its Work Order is completed.
When project work is carried out through Field Service, the Work Order often represents the execution of a specific Project Task. With this capability, organizations can configure Work Order Types so that completing the Work Order also completes the associated Project Task.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Bring project material plans into field execution
items.description:
When the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled, material estimates created in a project plan can now create connected Work Order Products on the related Field Service work order. This allows project-planned materials to flow into Field Service without requiring project and field teams to recreate material lines, keeping both teams aligned on the same material plan.
As before, Work Order Products can create material estimates when materials are added from Field Service durin

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
items.description: Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External phone call routing (GCC High, DoD)
items.description: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Prevent presence transition to "Do not disturb" setting when screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
items.description: We're introducing a setting that allows users to opt-out of transitioning presence automatically to Do Not Disturb when presenting or screen sharing. This ensures that they can continue to receive calls, keeping them connected and responsive without manual presence adjustments.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
items.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Insights and policy recommendations on Microsoft Copilot and AI Apps interactions for better Data Security and Compliance posture
items.description: Provide insights on Copilots and AI Apps usage and recommend retention policies for customers to govern their Copilots and AI App interactions. Updated September 15, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Power user insights in Copilot dashboard
items.description: Understand who is building a habit using Copilot with the new power user insights in Copilot dashboard

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Deep citations in Copilot
items.description: Deep citations let users quickly verify Copilot's results by linking directly to the relevant part of the reference, boosting trust. We're starting with Word and PPT files, then adding Meetings, Web, and PDF references.

items.title: Outlook: Enriching profile cards with custom, organization-specific properties
items.description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding custom properties unique to their organization. These properties can be sourced from external systems like HR platforms, enriching user profiles with relevant organizational details. Tenant admins can configure these properties with a display name and icon, which will appear in the Contact Information section of the profile cards.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Add references to your Copilot Notebooks from the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app
items.description: Users can quickly add references to a Copilot Notebook through the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Metadata understanding support for queries scoped to SharePoint document libraries or folders
items.description: We’re introducing column metadata support for queries in Microsoft 365 Copilot when a SharePoint library or folder is attached or its URL is provided. This enhancement improves contextual relevance by enabling Copilot to leverage additional metadata from the selected library, delivering more accurate and meaningful results.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations integration
items.description: Launch a pre-scoped Data Security Investigation (DSI) from an IRM case. When a data security admin identifies a risky user who needs deeper investigation, they can launch a pre-scoped investigation directly from an IRM case, allowing them to view content analysis related to that user and better assess post-incident data impact. items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Collection policies impact on IRM
items.description: With this update, Microsoft Purview will start supporting collection policies. Collection policies allow customers to scope classification (SITs - Sensitive Information Types) and activities for scoped users. We recommend reviewing collection policies as they can be created by different Purview solution admins to ensure they are setup to detect the activities required by Insider Risk Management policies Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential ma

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Expanding access to Diagnostics to Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management
items.description: We are expanding the access to Diagnostics beyond Global Admin to: Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management

items.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity Label support in Engage
items.description: Your organization can now manually apply Information Protection sensitivity labels in Engage. Sensitivity label support in this new application will allow admins to create labels and configure label publishing policies to determine which users and groups can manually label content in Engage. End users will be able to manually apply labels to Engage communities and in turn classify and protect their sensitive data via privacy and external user access controls.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Endpoint DLP shows full path of target domain
items.description: Endpoint DLP should show full path of target domain and not just the domain name in Activity Explorer.
